visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-content form with split field rows, reCAPTCHA slot, centred skewed submit and disclaimer
visualCharacteristics.layout: Square 40px fields, split rows, centred skewed submit button

contentPattern.structure: one row per form line; each cell is one field whose text is its label (2-3 cells = split row); a cell with a list is a select; textarea/email/tel/file inferred from labels

usage: Contact, careers, sample request, credit application and other form pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse form for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
